description: This file defines an interface 'InterestRateChartReadPlatformService' that provides methods for retrieving interest rate chart data in the Apache Fineract project. It includes method declarations for fetching interest rate charts and related data, some of which are commented out.

classes.name: InterestRateChartReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to read interest rate chart data within the Fineract portfolio interest rate chart module.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single interest rate chart by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllWithSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves all interest rate charts with slabs for a given savings product.

methods.name: retrieveAllWithSlabsWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves all interest rate charts with slabs along with templates for a given savings product.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interest rate chart with slabs by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves an interest rate chart with associated template data.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabsOnProductId
methods.description: Retrieves an interest rate chart with slabs for a specific product ID.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or viewing an interest rate chart.

methods.name: retrieveActiveChartWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active interest rate chart along with its template for a specific product.
